The Hidden Risk Factors for Oral, Head & Neck Cancer

When people think about oral, head, and neck cancers, tobacco and alcohol are often considered the main causes. While they are significant risk factors, they are not the only ones. Early signs may include persistent mouth ulcers, difficulty swallowing, a lump in the neck, hoarseness of voice, unexplained bleeding, or white and red patches inside the mouth. Unfortunately, these symptoms are often ignored until the disease progresses.
